svg.title: InnovatEPAM Portal (innovatepam-portal)
svg.desc: InnovatEPAM Portal, repository innovatepam-portal. An internal innovation platform. Employees submit ideas, administrators review them through a configurable multi-stage pipeline, and results are tracked with analytics. Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
